svg.title: WA3 assembly and test workstation — hardware, cables, printed fixtures and process events
svg.desc: Proportional L-shaped T3 table with 120 by 55 centimetre test wing and 65 by 70 centimetre assembly wing. Equipment includes the pressure mat's existing two-channel circuit, a separate observation Nano, a separate Nano DUT test jig, workpiece camera, reference scale and four reference weights, explicit approval UI, staging tray, Raspberry Pi, power supply and site network. Blue USB, violet sensor, red power and teal Ethernet cables meet named ports. Amber dashed connections require an approved DUT interface, scale protocol or UI integration. All ten printed fixture instances are shown and listed. The software diagram identifies implemented serial capture and event validation, pending adapters, and exact candidate, authoritative and diagnostic MQTT topic patterns.
svg.text: USB A: observer · USB B: DUT jig

Raw frames, samples and procedure files stay local.
